title: Thin Harness, Strong Contracts: Production-Oriented Agent Harnesses for Stateful AI Agents
abstract_short: This paper argues that production-oriented agent harnesses should be thin around model cognition but strong at system boundaries: tool contracts, permissions, state diffs, replay, memory scoping, audit, and review.
primary_claim: Capability-patch harnesses tend to become technical debt as models improve, while system-boundary harnesses become durable infrastructure.
